The source daily f_sigma()[1] is distinct from chart-bar sample history; changing the multiplier does not recalibrate its fixed statistics. MAE is measured from the open over the whole touch chart bar through reversion, while far-side MFE is drawn only after reversion.
finding: The producer takes 19 log returns from at most 20 closes, starts with only five closes, and can substitute an RTH close. Both-side touch chooses smaller overshoot instead of distance from the bar open. ext_max is only the touch-bar extension. July10 returns from upper29959.91 to 08:00 open29816.75; January10 lower21232.94 touch does not return to21320.75 by noon. These validate observations of the named implemented variant, not the printed sigma distribution.

Preserve both the source one-minute lookup and its deep-history/chart fallback, chart timeframe and available lower-timeframe coverage. Require 21 consecutive eligible completed session closes to form exactly20 simple returns r_i=100*(C_i/C_(i−1)−1). Use sample standard deviation with denominator19, all returns known before08:00. Identify the contract, daily-session convention and roll policy; missing session closes cannot fall back to RTH without a separately named variant.

At08:00 freeze O, σ_px=O*sd(r)/100 and all displayed O±kσ_px levels. Scan08:00–12:00 for the first upper/lower touch. On a both-side minute use distance from that minute open, upper on equality, for the literal source branch; record the tie and original OHLC.

Track return to O and the entire extension path until return/end, using the resolved same-minute policy. Measure touched-side excursion from O and opposite-side MFE only after reversion. Retain per-touch side/hour, known_at, first return, milestone times and conditional counts; do not pool incomplete/no-touch sessions as failures. Keep fixed hour/side tables, pooled milestone tables and local empirical counts separate. Mark the first visit of any independently selected high/low target as retirement of its active line; sigma and open reference bands retain their expressly defined statistical lifecycle and do not reset on every crossing.

Later low<=upper bound fills an up gap; later high>=lower bound fills a down gap. Store first near-edge fill, optional named mid/far fills and censoring at the selected horizon. title: MVFL source delta clusters, anomaly zones and seven-vote state
source: MVFL source is a seven-vote hysteresis indicator using OHLC-signed sub-bar volume. RULES explicitly asks for an aggressor-delta rebuild, while FORMULAS presents the literal OHLC version; that conflict stops faithful certification. FORMULAS also clusters at close, but source bullish events use body bottom and bearish body top, weighted by absolute delta. The historical assistant upgrade proposal is not source-author proof of equivalence. C7 tests the anomaly CENTRE, not either box edge. Weighted k-means centres assign membership, but final bounds centre at (member min+member max)/2, padded to minimum0.4ATR thickness. showDeltaAreas gates cluster recalculation and therefore C4 state; ordinary sigEvent, anomaly creation and alerts continue outside plotting sessions.
finding: The actual scorer is AM max print>=100lots AND AM price range>=8ticks:425/647. It never calls r_p20_mvfl and builds none of the source zones or seven votes. July10 max245lots/range1266ticks passes; October8 max92/range748 fails. The unused helper doubles anomaly thickness (±0.2% instead of±0.1%), and its passing fixture expects that wrong width.
fix: Stop the faithful MVFL row and preserve the unresolved source-versus-aggressor upgrade decision. Name the literal OHLC variant, any later trusted aggressor variant and the unrelated print/range filter separately. Do not implement missing clusters or claim the upgrade already exists in this audit.

For a later chosen literal port, declare primary chart timeframe separately from htf=5, mtf_conf=5 and ltf=1. Five-minute chart bars are the FORMULAS study configuration, not a universal source resampling. Chart-bar Δ=sum(sign(C−O)*V) over selected sub-bars, with source fallback to chart candle sign*V when the sub-bar array is empty; mark that fallback separately from complete data. Dynamic signal iff abs(Δ)>max(6*SMA50(absΔ),3000), current completed chart bar included; fixed-threshold mode is separate. Significant sign persists at all hours; only cluster INSERTIONS and plotting use default02–16 NY. Event pools persist across days, max3000 detections each side.

Use bullish event price=min(O,C), bearish=max(O,C), weight=absΔ. For each side separately set keff=min(4,n), seed sorted-price indices floor((j+0.5)/keff*n) capped n−1, run12 weighted nearest-centre iterations, ties to first index and retain an empty cluster’s prior centre. After membership assignment retain each cluster min/max, weight/count and earliest member time. Keep weight>=45% of strongest across both sides. Actual bounds are md±max((max−min)/2,0.4*ATR14/2), md=(min+max)/2; the weighted assignment centre is NOT the zone midpoint. Source updates only on a new event on the corresponding side and only when showDeltaAreas is true. Preserve this drawing-toggle dependency in literal mode and name any correction. Backdrawn earliest time is display origin, not availability.

For volume anomalies require volume>2.5*SMA20(volume), source includes current bar. Zone is close±0.001*close, full0.2% thickness. Merge centres within0.5% by retaining larger-volume event, maximum50. Keep centre, chosen event volume, created/updated times and every retired version. Merge distance is <=0.005*NEW close; scan existing centres in reverse, delete weaker neighbours and abort addition on a neighbour of greater/equal volume, retaining any earlier deletions from that loop in literal mode. New centres enter before C7 scoring, no automatic daily expiry. vaShowZones affects drawing, not this numeric centre pool.

Store each of seven votes: C1 requested HTF C versus SMA200; C2 persistent last significant delta sign; C3 SMA3 of rolling close median27 versus SMA50; C4 delta-cluster EDGE cross/rejection; C5 prior requested MTF six-vote local-majority regime (ties bullish); C6 SMA5 versus SMA200; C7 anomaly CENTRE cross/rejection. For every tested L: bullish iff (C>L and previousC<=L) or (C>L and low<=L and previousLow>L); bearish iff (C<L and previousC>=L) or (C<L and high>=L and previousHigh<L). Iterate in literal stored-level order, persisting the LAST matching vote; this is not intrabar event ordering. Current cluster/anomaly updates happen before tests and current L is used against prior price fields. Unshifted HTF C1/C3/C6 can develop in real time even with default lookahead_off; distinguish a closed-HTF causal policy.

Preserve initial bearish bias and flip only at least4of7 votes for the other side, otherwise persist. Store all votes and their input availability at each close. Evaluate any added hold/reject or next-bar direction outcome only afterward under its own label. Fix the anomaly fixture to source width and require a producer integration test; unused helper passes cannot certify the scored MVFL family. C5 uses prior-context regime[1] with lookahead_off and is not the final hysteresis state. Missing/zero votes are neutral; final regime starts bearish. Alerts and anomaly state are not suppressed merely because London/NY drawing is hidden. Cluster/anomaly zones have source update/merge lifecycles; external session high/low references remain separate first-revisit objects if used by a named later strategy.
